description: Search live one-way, round-trip, open-jaw, or multi-city flights (1 or 2 ordered legs). Returns ranked itineraries with prices, segments, baggage info, and an ignav_id. Pass an itinerary's ignav_id to get_booking_links for direct booking URLs.

departure_time_range.description: Optional airport-local departure and arrival hour bounds for this leg.

destination.description: 3-letter IATA destination airport or metro code (e.g. JFK, PAR).
destination.title: Destination

max_stops.description: Maximum stops allowed on this leg (0 for nonstop, 1, or 2). Omit for any.
max_stops.title: Max Stops

origin.description: 3-letter IATA origin airport or metro code (e.g. SFO, LON).
origin.title: Origin

TimeRangeInput.description: Inclusive airport-local hour bounds; the full latest hour is included.

arrival_earliest_hour.description: Earliest arrival hour (0-23, destination airport local time).
arrival_earliest_hour.title: Arrival Earliest Hour

arrival_latest_hour.description: Latest arrival hour (0-23, destination airport local time; full hour included).
arrival_latest_hour.title: Arrival Latest Hour

earliest_hour.description: Earliest departure hour (0-23, origin airport local time).
earliest_hour.title: Earliest Hour

latest_hour.description: Latest departure hour (0-23, origin airport local time; full hour included).
latest_hour.title: Latest Hour

TimeRangeInput.title: TimeRangeInput

adults.description: Number of adult passengers (1+). Max 9 total passengers.
adults.title: Adults

allow_mixed_carriers.description: Allow multiple reported marketing carriers within a leg. This does not describe ticketing or connection protection.
allow_mixed_carriers.title: Allow Mixed Carriers

cabin_class.description: Preferred cabin class: economy, premium_economy, business, or first.
cabin_class.title: Cabin Class

carry_on_bags.description: Requested total carry-on bags for the party, up to one per traveler with a seat. Zero, null or omitted means no preference. Prices include estimated bag fees where available.
carry_on_bags.title: Carry On Bags

checked_bags.description: Requested total checked bags for the party, up to one per traveler with a seat. Zero, null or omitted means no preference.
checked_bags.title: Checked Bags

infants_in_seat.description: Number of infants with their own seat.
infants_in_seat.title: Infants In Seat

infants_on_lap.description: Number of lap infants (cannot exceed adults).
infants_on_lap.title: Infants On Lap

legs.description: 1 or 2 ordered chronological legs. Use 1 leg for one-way, 2 reciprocal legs for round-trip, or 2 arbitrary legs for open-jaw or multi-city.
legs.title: Legs

market.description: 2-letter country code affecting pricing currency and locale (e.g. US, GB).
market.title: Market

max_price.description: Maximum whole-trip price in the selected market currency.
max_price.title: Max Price

max_results.description: Maximum number of ranked itineraries to return.
max_results.title: Max Results

name: search_flights

has_mixed_carriers.description: True when a leg contains multiple reported marketing carriers. Missing carrier codes are ignored; this does not describe ticketing or connection protection.
has_mixed_carriers.title: Has Mixed Carriers

observed_at.description: UTC time Ignav finished retrieving this search result; null when unknown. Not a guarantee of the current fare.
observed_at.title: Observed At

title: Search flights
